recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Revisit only if future generated dataelements.json or dataelements.xml artifacts reintroduce duplicate resource-bearing fullUrl/version pairs.
issue_request: FHIR-26461 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I issue asking whether R4 fhir-spec.zip site\dataelements.json was invalid because its collection Bundle repeated seven de-Quantity fullUrl plus resource.meta.versionId values under bdl-7; the approved resolution was to update in R5.
initial_application: No FHIR-26461-tagged source commit was found. The dataelements JSON/XML files are generated publication artifacts rather than checked-in source, and artifact checks show the R4 file reproduced the seven duplicates while R4B, R5, and current output have zero duplicate resource-bearing fullUrl/version pairs.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes from 2020-04-27 corroborate the R5 update motion and 8-0-0 vote. Later bdl-7 issues FHIR-31986 and FHIR-39476 are already represented on the combined branch and leave the current invariant compatible with the generated dataelements output.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. The current generated artifact already satisfies the reported uniqueness condition, and the relevant Bundle invariant refinements have been handled by later issue-specific commits.

related_jiras.note: Older DSTU1 Published/Persuasive issue reported duplicate fullUrl/canonical values in validation.zip dataelements.xml; it is useful background for generated dataelements artifacts but not part of the current R4/R5 seed decision.
Later Published issue refined Bundle bdl-7 to apply to entries where resource is present; its source fix is already on the combined branch.
Later Published issue refined bdl-7 handling of missing meta.versionId; its audit is already on the combined branch.
